issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: oak_hanging_sign, red_wall_banner.
459 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.roof: False alarm on the automatic 'roof has no overhang' warning: the renders and layers show a 1-block eave all round (x3 and x11 at y4 over walls x4..10; z1 and z13 over walls z2..12). The props L2 adds outside the walls (hanging sign post and crates on the east side) widen the footprint the check compares against.
notes.purpose: Hanging sign, red banners and lanterns on the front now say tavern at a glance.
notes.life: Lanterns and smoke, but still no plants.

visual.summary: L1 plus a projecting hanging sign, front lanterns on chains, red banners, chandeliers inside, crates/kegs by the kitchen side and a lit campfire on the chimney for smoke.
problems: Chimney top with the campfire (x7 y8 z13) sits level with the ridge (y8): one more brick under it would make the smoke clear the roof.
oak_hanging_sign and red_wall_banner are not yet builder-tested (automatic info).
Reach: 163 of 270 reached; unreached are roof slopes, ridge and chimney-side tops only, floor and rooms reached: fine.

notes.levels: Adds a real new function, visible from the side and back: an open outdoor kitchen under a lean-to by the kitchen door (second smoker, prep table, supply barrel), plus a serving hatch and a table for two inside. Not just decoration: meets Carlton's v1 note.
notes.roof: The automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm (the lean-to and props stand outside the eaves); the main roof has a 1-block overhang all round. Chimney reaches the ridge.
notes.artefacts: Hanging lanterns and the hanging sign all have a block or chain above them.

visual.summary: L2 adds a second job to the hall: an outdoor kitchen lean-to with its own smoker and prep table, a serving hatch between kitchen and hall and more seating, on top of the L1 hall with its new sign, lanterns, chandeliers and banners.
problems: oak_hanging_sign and red_wall_banner are not yet builder-tested (automatic info).

Reach: 161 of 272 standing places reached; the unreached ones are main roof slopes, the ridge, the lean-to roof (x12 y3 z9-12) and the two chimney-side brick tops at y4 z13; the whole floor, kitchen, outdoor kitchen and rooms are reached: fine.
